newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-E.TRANSVAAL BEAT SWD 31-20 IN CURRIE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-E.TRANSVAAL BEAT SWD 31-20 IN CURRIE CUP.

text.p: South Western Districts produced their best result so far in the 1996 Currie Cup but were still beaten 31-20 (halftime 16-6) by Eastern Transvaal at the Outeniqua Park Stadium in George on Saturday.

The visitors opened a 10 point lead through tries from centre Eugene Meyer and wing I.P. van der Merwe while flyhalf Jaco Viljoen and hooker Hennie Pieterse added further tries to maintain Easterns' control of the game.

SWD lost both locks and their eighthman through injury which allowed Easterns to dominate the battle for forward possession but might still have done better had flyhalf Juri Coetzee not endured a miserable day with the boot.
South Western Districts - Tries: Nico Heunif, Paul Treu. Conversions: Juri Coetzee (2). Penalties: Coetzee (2).
Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Eugene Meyer, I.P.van der Merwe, Jaco Viljoen, Hennie Pieterse. Conversion: Jaco Viljoen. Penalties: Viljoen (3)
